title: Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes: The Ceiling an Issued Credit Is Held To
content:
Clause on the ceiling to which a credit issued under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is held. Where the value the customer declared the piece at stands on the upgrade desk's request record, that declared value sets the ceiling, subject to the programme's largest credit for one traded piece.

## Clause

Where the value the customer declared the piece at stands on the upgrade desk's request record and exceeds the programme's largest credit for one traded piece, the credit is held to that largest credit. Where the value they declared stands on that record and is at or below the programme's largest credit, the credit is held to the value they declared. Where no such declared value stands on that record, the credit issued is held to the price the piece originally sold for.

The declared value is the amount on the request record the customer has confirmed for that registration; where several stand, the most recent by its effective date governs.

## The ceiling by programme

| Programme | Largest credit for one traded piece (USD) |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 4999 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 24999 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 39999 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 74999 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 199999 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 149999 |

## Cases under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee, on a piece that originally sold for 18000 USD

| Declared value on the request record | Ceiling (USD) |
|---|---|
| 30000 USD | 24999 |
| 24999 USD | 24999 |
| 12000 USD | 12000 |
| none standing | 18000 |
